description:
Presenting this spacious and well-appointed garden studio flat, ideally situated in the heart of Clifton just off the vibrant Whiteladies Road, offering effortless access to an array of local amenities, cafes, shops, and transport links. 

The property is available unfurnished, The kitchen is very spacious and thoughtfully designed to accommodate a range of appliances and ample storage, making it perfect for those who enjoy cooking or entertaining. T

he main studio area is bright and versatile, with plenty of room to create distinct living, dining, and sleeping zones to suit your lifestyle. The south-facing aspect ensures the space is filled with natural light throughout the day, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The property does come with a spacious garden for you to enjoy!

The flat falls within Council Tax Band 'A', offering an economical choice for prospective tenants. Energy performance is rated 'E', and the property is well maintained, ready for occupation from the 14th of September. 

This is a rare opportunity to secure a superb studio flat in one of Bristol’s most desirable locations, with excellent connections to the city centre, the University of Bristol, and local green spaces. This property is sure to impress with its combination of size, location, and value. Early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate all that this charming Clifton studio has to offer.

EPC Rating 'E'
Council Tax Band 'A' 
On Street Permit Parking
keyFeatures: Garden Studio Flat - Great Size Garden in Heart of Clifton
